text: 随记 Jot 是 DSH 的网页端笔记插件，可在对话右侧打开，也能从左侧导航进入完整页面。它把笔记保存在本机，支持富文本编辑、标题和正文搜索、文件夹与待办清单。用户可导入 Markdown 笔记，并将笔记库导出为 Word、PDF 或 Markdown。开启 AI 协作后，DSH 工具可按需查找、读取、新建和修改笔记；默认关闭，无需 API Key。

Jot is a DSH web notes plugin with a main page and conversation sidebar. It stores notes locally and supports rich text, search, folders, and checklists. Import Markdown; export to Word, PDF, or Markdown. Optional AI tools access notes when enabled. No API key is needed.

随记 Jot 的功能「富文本笔记」：在 DSH 页面或对话侧栏打开编辑器，记录标题、正文、清单和表格等笔记内容，并保存在本机目录。
随记 Jot 的功能「搜索与归类」：按标题或正文查找笔记，并可按文件夹整理；清单支持查看待办进度。
随记 Jot 的功能「按需 AI 协作」：用户开启协作后，DSH 工具可搜索、读取、新建、修改笔记和切换待办状态；关闭时工具撤销注册。
随记 Jot 的功能「笔记导入导出」：选择 Markdown、文本文件夹或 Jot ZIP 导入；笔记库可导出为 Word、PDF 或 Markdown 格式的归档。
随记 Jot 的使用前须知：AI 协作默认关闭；开启后 DSH 工具才会按请求访问笔记，关闭时工具会撤销注册。（见 src/index.ts:36-44）

dsh-jot README · Introduction：

随记 Jot

对话旁边的笔记本。
在 DeepSeek Harness 里边聊边记，也能让 AI 把讨论结果记进笔记。

安装 · 使用指南 · 更新记录 · English
dsh-jot README · Introduction：

dsh-jot README · 能做什么：- **边聊边记**：随记就开在对话右侧，输入 `/jot` 可以打开、新建或找到一篇笔记；要写长一点的内容，从左侧导航进入完整页面。
- **像文档一样写**：标题、清单、表格、链接、图片和附件都有，不用会 Markdown。空行输入 `/` 插入内容，按 `?` 查看全部快捷键。
- **让 AI 帮忙**：打开 AI 协作后，AI 可以查找、新建和修改笔记；它改过的地方会标出来，不满意可以撤回。
- **找得到**：标题和正文都能搜。常用的置顶，按文件夹归类，清单在列表里直接显示完成进度。
- **导入导出**：可以导入 Obsidian 等 Markdown 笔记；整个笔记库能导出成 Word、PDF 或 Markdown，导出的压缩包还能原样导回来。
- **存在本机**：笔记保存在 DSH 的数据目录里，不上传云端，卸载插件也不会删除。

dsh-jot README · 和 AI 一起用：AI 协作默认关闭，在笔记列表底部打开。之后直接在对话里说：

> 把刚才定的三件事记到随记「周会」，写上负责人。
>
> 把「周会」里的第一条待办勾掉。

AI 只改需要改的地方：改几个字，就只换那几个字，原来的标题、列表和颜色都会保留。AI 改过的已有笔记会标上「AI 修改」，点一下就能撤回这一轮修改。

协作关闭时，随记不会出现在对话可用的工具里；打开以后，AI 也只在你提出要求时才读笔记。
dsh-jot README · npm / CLI：```sh
dsh-jot README · 桌面客户端：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-jot

dsh-jot README · DSH Web：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jot
```

装好后重启 DSH，左侧导航会多出「随记」。桌面版和 Web 版需要分别安装。还没有 `dsh` 命令的话，可以在官方桌面应用的菜单「管理 dsh 命令…」里安装，需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`。

DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 Web 升级需先移除随记再重新安装，笔记和附件保留；CLI 操作前先停止对应 Host。官方 macOS Desktop 已验收版本仍为 0.2.0-rc.2，使用自己的 Profile 和内置 CLI。具体升级、卸载和备份方法见[使用指南](./docs/GUIDE.zh-CN.md#安装升级与卸载)。

dsh-jot README · Discover：DSH 从 0.2.1-alpha.4 起引入自定义插件市场，也可以通过 Discover 安装：

1. 打开 **插件 → 实验性插件 → 更多**，启用 **自定义插件市场**。
2. 进入 **发现（Discover）→ 添加索引源**，粘贴 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Totoro-qaq/dsh-plugin-index/main/index.json`。
3. 选择 **随记 Jot**，核对包名 `dsh-jot`、版本和 npm 来源 `https://registry.npmjs.org/`，确认安装后点 **立即启用**。

这是[作者维护的第三方源](https://github.com/Totoro-qaq/dsh-plugin-index)，不代表 DSH 官方认证或社区审核，不会自动添加给所有用户。本次 Discover 流程在隔离的 alpha.4 WebHost 验收，未新增原生桌面验收；看不到 Discover 时，继续用上面的 npm 方式安装即可。

dsh-jot README · 常见问题：**笔记存在哪里？** 默认在 `~/.dsh/jot`；设置了 `DSH_HOME` 时在 `$DSH_HOME/jot`。桌面版和 Web 版指向同一个目录时，笔记是共用的。

**卸载或升级会丢笔记吗？** 不会，笔记和插件分开存放。

**能从 Obsidian 搬过来吗？** 能。在列表的「排序与选项」里选「导入笔记」，选中整个笔记库文件夹即可，图片和附件会一起导入。

dsh-jot README · 兼容性：Jot **0.2.14** 修复了旧 profile 中 PDF 依赖损坏导致整个插件无法启动的问题。PDF 和 Word 导出分别做后台预检，异常时提前提示并只停用对应格式；笔记、Markdown 和纯文本导出不受影响。已在官方 macOS 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2 的旧锁环境完成原生编辑、滚动、导出、故障隔离和恢复验收，范围见[本版记录](./docs/VALIDATION.md#0214--legacy-profile-export-isolation)。这不是存储迁移，不会清理笔记或其他插件。

Jot **0.2.13** 支持官方 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 Web。Host/Client 运行时与本轮受测的 0.2.12 开发候选包字节一致：与 Bridge 共同完成编辑、搜索、待办、表格、附件与导出验收，禁用恢复、同业务字节卸载重装和正常重启也保留了笔记及附件。具体受测包身份和范围见[验证记录](./docs/VALIDATION.md#0213--dsh-021-alpha3-web-compatibility)。

dsh-jot README · 兼容性：此前已验收 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2（官方 macOS 桌面版）和 0.2.1-alpha.1 / alpha.2（Web）。本轮未新增 alpha.3 原生桌面、桌面字号快捷键、Windows/Linux 真机或任意其他插件组合的验收，也未认证不同业务代码的热替换。

dsh-jot README · Introduction：

Jot

A notebook beside your conversation.
Take notes while you chat in DeepSeek Harness, and let AI write down what you decided.

dsh-jot README · Introduction：

Install · Guide · Changelog · 简体中文

dsh-jot README · What it does：- **Notes beside the chat**: Jot opens to the right of the conversation. Type `/jot` to open, create or find a note, or open the full page from the left navigation for longer writing.
- **Write like a document**: headings, checklists, tables, links, images and attachments, with no Markdown required. Type `/` on an empty line to insert anything, and press `?` for every shortcut.
- **Help from AI**: once you turn on AI collaboration, AI can find, create and edit notes. Its changes are marked, and you can take them back.
- **Easy to find**: search titles and text, pin what you use often, sort notes into folders, and see checklist progress right in the list.
- **Import and export**: bring in Markdown notes from Obsidian and similar apps. Export your whole library to Word, PDF or Markdown, and import the ZIP back exactly as it was.
- **Stays on your computer**: notes live in DSH's data folder, never in the cloud, and uninstalling Jot keeps them.

dsh-jot README · Working with AI：AI collaboration is off until you turn it on at the bottom of the note list. Then just ask in the conversation:

> Add those three to-dos to Weekly sync in Jot, with owners and dates.
>
> Check off the first to-do in Weekly sync.

AI changes only what it needs to: change a few words and only those words change, while your headings, lists and colors stay as they were. When AI changes an existing note, the note is marked **AI edited**; select the mark to undo that round of changes.
dsh-jot README · Working with AI：While collaboration is off, Jot's tools are not offered to the conversation at all. When it is on, AI reads notes only when you ask.
dsh-jot README · npm / CLI：```sh
dsh-jot README · Desktop app：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-jot

dsh-jot README · DSH Web：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-jot
```

Restart DSH and **Jot** appears in the left navigation. Desktop and Web are installed separately. If you don't have the `dsh` command yet, install it from **Manage dsh commands…** in the official desktop app's menu; it needs Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`.

dsh-jot README · DSH Web：For DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 Web, remove Jot before reinstalling to upgrade; notes and attachments are retained. Stop the corresponding Host before using the CLI. The verified official macOS Desktop remains 0.2.0-rc.2 and uses its own profile and bundled CLI. Upgrade, removal and backup instructions are in the [guide](./docs/GUIDE.en.md#install-upgrade-and-remove).

dsh-jot README · Discover：DSH introduced custom plugin markets in 0.2.1-alpha.4. On versions that support them:

1. Open **Plugins → Experimental plugins → More** and enable **Custom plugin markets**.
2. Open **Discover → Add index source** and paste `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Totoro-qaq/dsh-plugin-index/main/index.json`.
3. Select **Jot**, check the package name `dsh-jot`, version and npm registry `https://registry.npmjs.org/`, then confirm installation and choose **Enable now**.

dsh-jot README · Discover：This is an [author-maintained third-party source](https://github.com/Totoro-qaq/dsh-plugin-index); it does not imply DSH certification or community approval and is not added automatically for every user. This Discover flow was verified in an isolated alpha.4 WebHost, not native Desktop. If Discover is unavailable, use the npm method above.

dsh-jot README · FAQ：**Where are my notes?** In `~/.dsh/jot`, or in `$DSH_HOME/jot` when `DSH_HOME` is set. Desktop and Web share notes when they point to the same folder.

**Will uninstalling or upgrading lose notes?** No. Notes are stored separately from the plugin.

**Can I move in from Obsidian?** Yes. Choose **Import notes** under **Sort and options** in the list and pick your vault folder; images and attachments come along.

dsh-jot README · Compatibility：Jot **0.2.14** fixes startup failures caused by a broken PDF dependency retained in an older profile. PDF and Word exports have independent background preflight checks: a failure is reported before export and disables only that format. Notes, Markdown and plain-text exports remain independent. Native editing, scrolling, downloads, fault isolation and recovery passed on official macOS Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 with the old lock retained; see the [version-specific record](./docs/VALIDATION.md#0214--legacy-profile-export-isolation). This is not a storage migration and does not clean up notes or other plugins.

dsh-jot README · Compatibility：Jot **0.2.13** supports official DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 Web. Its Host/Client bundles are byte-identical to the 0.2.12 development candidate that passed editing, search, task, table, attachment and export checks together with Bridge. Disable/re-enable, removal/reinstallation of identical business bundles, and a normal Host restart retained notes and attachments. See the [validation record](./docs/VALIDATION.md#0213--dsh-021-alpha3-web-compatibility) for the exact tested package and scope.

dsh-jot README · Compatibility：Earlier acceptance covers DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (official macOS desktop app) and 0.2.1-alpha.1 / alpha.2 (Web). This pass adds no acceptance for native alpha.3 Desktop, Desktop font-size shortcuts, physical Windows/Linux systems, arbitrary other plugin combinations, or hot replacement with changed business code.
